div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: train_ddp(world_size=4, epochs)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
mp.get_context('spawn')
launches 4 separate OS processes,
one per rank (0,1,2,3)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EACH rank independently runs
run_worker(rank, world_size, epochs)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
setup(rank, world_size)
dist.init_process_group(
backend='gloo', rank, world_size)
— all 4 ranks must call this
before ANY proceeds

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DistributedSampler(dataset,
num_replicas=world_size, rank=rank)
— each rank gets a DIFFERENT
1/world_size slice of the data

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
torch.manual_seed(0)
— identical init on every rank
BEFORE DDP wrapping

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DistributedDataParallel(model)
— registers autograd hooks that will
all-reduce gradients automatically

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
for epoch in
range(epochs)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
for X, y in
this rank's DataLoader
(only ITS shard)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ddp_model(X) → logits
loss = loss_fn(logits, y)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
loss.backward()
← THIS is where DDP intercepts:
all-reduces gradients across
ALL 4 ranks before returning

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
optimizer.step()
— every rank applies the SAME
(averaged) gradient

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
torch.save(model.state_dict(),
f'ddp_rank{rank}.pt')
— each rank saves its OWN copy

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: rank == 0?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
result_queue.put({final_loss, ...})
— only rank 0 reports back
to the parent process

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: no result reported

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: dist.destroy_process_group()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
parent process: p.join() on all 4
→ compare_weights.py can now
load all 4 .pt files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
max_pairwise_l2('ddp', world_size=4)
flatten each rank's state_dict,
compute L2 distance between
every pair of ranks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
max distance
< 1e-4?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROVEN: all ranks converged
to IDENTICAL weights
(measured: exactly 0.0)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ranks diverged
(this is what train_no_sync.py
produces instead: 0.3655)
